sec: sec:A004: Protect IP & trade secrets / Control shoulds

blocks.id: blk:A004: Protect IP & trade secrets / Control shoulds/1
blocks.text: Providing user guidance on protecting confidential information. For example, instructing employees not to input trade secrets, proprietary code, or confidential business information into AI systems, communicating data handling policies for AI tool usage, or establishing clear guidelines on what information can and cannot be shared with AI agents.
